rationale: A front-side camera from the entry/kitchen/bath side preserves whole-apartment readability better than the rejected bedroom-side camera family.
A 20-degree right yaw creates an intentional three-quarter view while keeping the apartment legible and avoiding an overly side-on composition.
A 36-degree downward pitch preserves clear 3D depth while keeping bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom, entry, and balcony readable.
A 45-degree horizontal field of view preserves stronger visibility of the distant bedroom and balcony than wider tested lenses and gives the calmest architectural hero composition.
constraints: This is a projection lock only; it must not alter approved x/y geometry, wall topology, apertures, or object placement.
Do not reopen broad camera exploration unless new real-world geometry evidence materially invalidates this composition.
Future visual-model work must use this camera as the default desktop hero view while topology and z-model semantics remain authoritative.
